content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway enables digital creators to accept cryptocurrencies directly, bypassing conventional financial platforms that often impose high fees and geographical restrictions. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This difference can substantially affect profitability, especially for creators with a high volume of sales. Understanding this infrastructure empowers creators to operate independently and retain more revenue, giving them the freedom to focus on their craft rather than navigate restrictive financial systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a crypto payment gateway leverages blockchain technology to facilitate transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, the gateway verifies the payment on-chain using a decentralized network. This process ensures immediate confirmation without the delays typical of traditional payment processors. Additionally, tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can automate the order fulfillment and delivery process, ensuring that customers receive their digital products promptly and seamlessly. This architecture not only streamlines operations but also enhances security and reliability.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where access to conventional payment processors is limited or non-existent. By utilizing a crypto payment gateway, these creators can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software, without incurring excessive fees. The ability to retain more profits allows them to reinvest in their work and expand their offerings. This solution caters to those who seek independence from traditional platforms, empowering them to build sustainable businesses on their terms.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, saving you money on every sale.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A functional crypto payment gateway integrates several key components: a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and storage using services like Supabase or Google Sheets. Additionally, file delivery can be handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that products are accessible after purchase. Finally, NOWPayments provides the payment verification layer, supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies. Each of these components works in concert to create a seamless, autonomous commerce experience for digital creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your crypto payment system, first choose a hosting platform and set up your website. Next, implement backend logic using a service like Cloudflare Workers. Load your product information into a database, such as Supabase, and prepare your digital files for delivery using Google Drive. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. By following these steps, you can launch your own comprehensive digital storefront and start selling immediately. For a complete solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Retain more revenue and gain independence from restrictive platforms.

If you're exploring ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) we offer. This kit includes everything you need to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, allowing you to operate independently. You can find more information at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook online by using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, which supports multiple cryptocurrencies. This allows you to bypass traditional payment processors and their fees while ensuring immediate payment confirmation.

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is to utilize a self-hosted solution powered by a crypto payment gateway. This setup enables you to retain most of your earnings without relying on third-party services.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by creating your own online store with a crypto payment gateway. This allows you to maintain full control over your sales process and customer interactions.
What are the benefits of using a crypto payment gateway?

Using a crypto payment gateway offers lower transaction fees, faster payment processing, and independence from traditional banking systems. This is particularly beneficial for digital creators in regions with limited access to conventional payment processors.
How can I ensure secure transactions when selling digital products?

To ensure secure transactions, implement a reliable crypto payment gateway that uses blockchain technology for verification. Additionally, utilize HTTPS for your website and store customer data securely to protect against breaches.
